rationale: B is better because it ties deal prioritization directly to expected revenue (close probability × deal amount × strategic weight), distinguishes high-revenue products from lower-revenue/high-growth opportunities, adds time-to-transition modeling, explainability, operational cadence, and concrete deliverables. Both responses under-address temporal validation, leakage, probability calibration, censored open deals, and causal measurement of revenue uplift, while proposing some unjustified thresholds and outputs; however, B provides the more coherent and actionable decision system for the stated revenue objective.
